intermittent_patterns.regex: Timedout executing command source.*cluster start in .* secs with error:
intermittent_patterns.description: Cluster start timeout - known intermittent issue
intermittent_patterns.action: Retry deployment, timeout likely due to network latency or temporary resource contention
intermittent_patterns.root_cause: Network delays or temporary AHV/CVM resource contention during cluster start sequence

intermittent_patterns.regex: Timedout executing command source.*cluster.*create in .* secs with error
intermittent_patterns.description: Cluster creation timeout - known intermittent issue
intermittent_patterns.action: Retry deployment, timeout likely due to network latency or temporary resource contention
intermittent_patterns.root_cause: Network delays or temporary AHV/CVM resource contention during cluster creation

intermittent_patterns.regex: Couldn't get handle to SVM VM object for ip
intermittent_patterns.description: SVM VM object handle retrieval failure - intermittent networking issue
intermittent_patterns.action: Retry deployment, issue typically resolves on subsequent attempts
intermittent_patterns.root_cause: Temporary networking issue preventing SVM VM object handle retrieval

intermittent_patterns.regex: SSH connection.*timeout|Unable to establish SSH connection
intermittent_patterns.description: SSH connection timeout - intermittent network connectivity issue
intermittent_patterns.action: Retry deployment, SSH timeouts are often transient network issues
intermittent_patterns.root_cause: Temporary network connectivity issues or target system load

intermittent_patterns.description: API connection timeout - intermittent service availability
intermittent_patterns.action: Retry deployment, API timeouts typically resolve automatically
intermittent_patterns.root_cause: Temporary API service overload or network connectivity issues
